related.title: Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore
related.why: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.whyEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.transfer: 可遷移張量、數值誤差及計算／記憶體收支；算子、精度與資料歸納假設需重設。
related.transferEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對矩陣陣列與可重組三維互連；Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore改以矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on matrix arrays and reconfigurable 3d interconnects; Google TPU v5p and SparseCore centers on matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照v4 MXU張量shape與v5p TensorCore，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到Google TPU v5p 與 SparseCore，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以Pod與slice尺寸為起點，設計一項能區分「矩陣陣列與可重組三維互連」與「矩陣、稀疏嵌入與大工作切片」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare v4 mxu tensor shapes with v5p tensorcore and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Google TPU v5p and SparseCore, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from pod and slice dimensions and propose an observation distinguishing matrix arrays and reconfigurable 3d interconnects from matrices, sparse embeddings and large job slices, including uncertainty.

related.title: AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統

related.transferEn: Tensor, numerical-error and compute/memory accounting transfer while operators, precision and data assumptions must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課針對矩陣陣列與可重組三維互連；AWS Trainium 與 Neuron 系統改以專用核心、編譯器及叢集共同設計為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。

practice: 對照v4 MXU張量shape與NeuronCore算術路徑，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。

practiceEn: Compare v4 mxu tensor shapes with neuroncore arithmetic paths and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to AWS Trainium and Neuron system, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from pod and slice dimensions and propose an observation distinguishing matrix arrays and reconfigurable 3d interconnects from specialized cores, compilers and cluster co-design, including uncertainty.
